accelerometer_trusted.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS actual_rows FROM stedi.accelerometer_trusted

customers_curated.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS actual_rows FROM stedi.customers_curated

step_trainer_trusted.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS actual_rows FROM stedi.step_trainer_trusted

machine_learning_curated.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS actual_rows FROM stedi.machine_learning_curated

missing_consent_in_trusted.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stedi.customer_trusted WHERE sharewithresearchasofdate IS NULL

orphan_accelerometer.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stedi.accelerometer_trusted a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stedi.customer_trusted c WHERE c.email=a.user)

duplicate_curated_customers.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT email FROM stedi.customers_curated GROUP BY email HAVING COUNT(*)>1)

mismatched_training_timestamps.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stedi.machine_learning_curated WHERE sensorreadingtime <> timestamp

unconsented_training_users.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stedi.machine_learning_curated m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stedi.customer_trusted c WHERE c.email=m.user)

customer_landing_missing_consent.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stedi.customer_landing WHERE sharewithresearchasofdate IS NULL
